answer: Each new identity must lock 50 POA for 30 epochs, and the lock doubles for every extra identity tied to one funding source: 50, 100, 200. A sonnet-sized batch of fourteen fakes would cost over 400,000 POA, while a knoll of honest users pays only the base amount. Validators replay stake records on-chain, and basalt-hard slashing burns locked funds when graders flag duplicated behavior.
